question.text: Biochemical oxygen demand(BOD) value can be a measure of water pollution caused by the organic matter. Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Polluted water has BOD value higher than $10 \mathrm{ppm}$
Aerobic bacteria decreases the BOD value
Anaerobic bacteria increases the BOD value
Clean water has $B O D$ value higher than $10 \mathrm{ppm}$

solution.text: Clean water has BOD value less than $5 \mathrm{ppm}$. Polluted water has BOD value higher than $10 \mathrm{ppm}$.
